text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During Mejiro Bright's dance lesson—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you mind taking a look at 
the choreography for the new song~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today, I would like to do a run-through 
practice with music for the first time~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well then, here I come~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ei, hup, one, two~. Pitter, patter, and 
away I go~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although Mejiro Bright had memorized the 
choreography thoroughly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*rustle rustle rustle~*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, my dancing keeps falling behind the 
music~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How should I go about riding the rhythm 
properly, I wonder~?
choice_data_list: Why not try dancing with someone?
Let's perfect it at this pace for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Matching the person you're dancing 
with, is it? That might be a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, is there anyone who would be willing 
to accompany me for some practice—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...That is right, Dober is also practicing 
this song~. Let us go and ask her~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Bright, I'll dance first, so just 
follow my lead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Dober, I look forward to working with 
you~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Here we go. 3, 2, 1, shoot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's dance, which had gone 
smoothly at first, gradually began to slow 
down—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(*rustle rustle rustle~*) (*rustle rustle 
rustle~*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... That's weird... I keep getting 
thrown off by Bright's movements...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, doing this alone might be tough. Hang 
on a sec. I'll go get Ryan too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm so grateful that even you joined 
me, Lady Ryan~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, Bright! Something 
like this is an absolute piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Leave keeping the rhythm to me, you two! 
Alright then, here we go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(*rustle rustle rustle~*) (*rustle rustle 
rustle~*) (*rustle rustle rustle~*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: H-Huh~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Bright's dancing has the 
power to make her carefree pace 
contagious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~ Let us save picking up the rhythm 
for later~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Once more, then. Here I go~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ei, hup, one, two~. Pitter, patter, and 
away~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*rustle rustle rustle~*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I watched Mejiro Bright's leisurely 
dance—
choice_data_list: (My head's starting to feel all foggy...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...'Rainer-sama, Trainer-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Curfew is approaching, so I would like to 
wrap up the lesson soon~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I realized it, night had already 
fallen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Bright's dancing has the 
power to warp one's sense of time...
